description: Makes a personal Git token for the workspace's kept code at CodeGene's own git address: the answer has the clone address, a username and password (what GitHub Importer at https://github.com/new/import asks for to copy the code with its history to the person's own GitHub), and ready git commands. With access read (the default) it clones and fetches; with access push it also pushes branches, but never the default branch, a branch a change going live holds, or a tag (going live moves the default branch). It is shown once and CodeGene keeps only a fingerprint of it, so give it to the person straight away and never write it anywhere else. It lasts 30 days unless days says otherwise (1 to 365). revoke_code_tokens ends it, and so does leaving the workspace.

access.description: read (the default) clones and fetches; push also pushes branches other than the default branch.

days.description: How many days the token lasts (1 to 365; 30 if left out).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
